text:
alex: Morning — quick async standup. What I did: finished the roadmap PR for v0.9 feature flags and added canary knobs. Deployed the beta UI to the staging slot. Blockers: still seeing flakey metrics on the latency dashboard (p95 spikes when batch sizes switch). Need help from eng-infra for tracing. Today: iterate on rollout gating and review @mira's spec for rollout triggers.

mira: Nice. What did the latency spikes look like? CPU? GPU? network?

alex: Mostly CPU at the GRPC worker, not GPU. Spikes coincide with autoscaler spin-ups and large batch requests. Attached sample logs below:```[2026-03-12T09:12:04Z] worker-3 CPU 92% - batch_size=64 - req=embed-gen
[2026-03-12T09:12:05Z] worker-3 kv_cache_miss=1 latency=420ms
```

sam: pinging eng-infra — @jordan can you take a look at the autoscaler+tracing config? I added a dashboard link: https://dash.redwood.local/d/latency/standup-sample :eyes:

jordan: saw the link, will dig in later this morning. Quick Q: are the spikes reproducible on a synthetic load? If so we can add a throttling rule during canary.

alex: I reproduced in staging with our perf harness (batch profile B2). Repro steps in the runbook: /runbooks/perf/batch-spike.md.

mira: On the rollout triggers spec: I left comments on the PR about thresholds and cooldown windows. TL;DR: prefer p50/p95 + error rate over single-p99 to avoid false positives. Also recommend an automatic rollback if error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 2 minutes.

tess: I reviewed the spec and 👍 on the p95 + error rate combo. One ask: add a manual override in Redwood Console so QE can force a pause.

alex: Good call. I'll add the override button and a guard in the backend. @sam can you help with Console front-end copy?

sam: Yep — can do. I'll send a short PR by EOD. Also quick blocker: need a code review on the canary router change (PR #4221). If anyone has 10 mins, please skim.

mira: On priority: are we still keeping model fallback (small -> medium) as non-blocking for launch? I thought the product asked it be mandatory for regulated customers.

alex: For GA launch we mark fallback as recommended but not mandatory for public tenants. For regulated/enterprise (Private) we'll enforce model variants via policy. Added note in the roadmap doc.

jordan: From infra perspective, the biggest risk is unexpected autoscaler churn. I'll add a temporary rate limiter during the first 24h of canary and a watch-run with alerting to paging.

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary deploy started for service=runtime canary_id=canary-2026-03-12-09-45

tess: Nice. Action items: (1) alex to add manual override and backend guard, (2) sam to PR Console copy, (3) jordon to add rate limiter + alerting, (4) mira to finalize thresholds in spec.

alex: I'll follow up with PR links here when ready. If no objections I plan to flip the canary to 10% traffic at 12:00 PST. :shipit:

mira: No objections from me.

sam: ack, will queue review after lunch. :eyes: 

jordan: ack. I'll post findings in eng-infra if I see anything odd.

alex: Thanks all — short check-in later after the canary starts.
